Welcome to my webpage! I am Raman, a UBC MDS student. I am in section 02.
I grew up in Punjab, India, and completed my
undergraduate degree in Physics at IIT Bombay in 2017.

I'm here to build a solid foundation in data science: statistics, machine
learning and the programming skills that go with them. This site is where I'll
share a bit about myself and write about what I'm learning along the way.

Outside of class, I love to cook, work out, read, and play spelling bee and
other word games.
